children: According to CNBC, Social Security benefits are set to increase 3.6% in January 2027, adding about $75 per month on average. The taxable earnings cap will rise to $192,300 from $184,500 in 2026, while the standard monthly Medicare Part B premium will increase to $209.40 from $202.90. Higher Medicare premiums could reduce beneficiaries’ net increase, and rising benefits may affect the portion subject to federal income taxes. Workers who earn at least $192,300 will pay $11,922.60 in Social Security payroll taxes in 2027, while self-employed workers will pay $23,845.20.

title: Social Security Benefits to Rise 3.6% in 2027, While Medicare and Tax Changes Could Affect Take-Home Amounts
